comment: Frozen scoring rules of task spec-01 (docs/specs/2026-10-02-bk-spec-design.md, 'The rules file' and 'Step 1 as built'). Every string is a case-insensitive regular expression. A hazard holds when one block of the spec satisfies every group: a string group must match somewhere in the block; a {"sentence": [...]} group needs one sentence of the block to match all its expressions. The SHA-256 of this file is written in the spec before the first session; after that the file does not change without the owner.

H1.what: the request contradicts the project's rule that a closed ticket is final and only a resolved one can be reopened, and the spec says so

sentence: \bfinal\b|immutable|never (be )?changed|cannot be changed|can ?not be reopened|can't be reopened|only (a )?resolved|glossary

H2.what: 14 days cannot hold as asked: a closed ticket's messages are purged after 7 days

sentence: purg|7[- ]?days?|seven[- ]days?|a week|one week|messages? (are|is|get|gets|will be|would be|have been) (deleted|removed|gone)|deletes? (the |their |its |all )?(messages|conversation)

H3.what: a ticket with no assignee: who is notified

sentence: unassigned|no assignee|without an? (assignee|agent|owner)|assignee(_id)?[^.]{0,20}null|null[^.]{0,20}assignee|no (assigned )?agent( is)? assigned|no assigned agent|not assigned|nobody (is )?assigned|no owner|has no agent

H4.what: the reopen is limited to tickets of the customer's own organisation

H5.what: the existing reopen is found: the agent-side reopenTicket named, or the file or the customer's reply named with what it already does

H6.what: whether the SLA due time is reset on reopen: an open question with a recommended answer, or a recorded decision or assumption

H7.what: what is out of scope: a section or a sentence naming at least one exclusion
H7.heading: out[- ]of[- ]scope|non-?goals?|not in scope|exclu
H7.inline: out[- ]of[- ]scope|non-?goals?|not in scope|not part of this|(does not|doesn't|will not|won't|do not|don't) (cover|includ|handl|build|address)|is not covered|not doing|not included
